A person behind the planning

Meet Sarah: an Iowa-based travel consultant with two decades of customer service experience and a love for adventures shared with the people who matter.

01

A real conversation

Start with your interests and your questions. You can contact Sarah directly by email or phone.

A thoughtful starting point

Room for your kind of adventure

From a daydream to a conversation

A simple place to begin.

01

Share your idea

Tell Sarah where you’d like to go, when you might travel, and who’s coming along. It’s okay if you’re still exploring.

02

Ask your questions

Discuss your priorities, budget, and the travel-planning help you’re looking for directly with Sarah.

03

Agree on the next step

Ask Sarah to confirm available services, any fees, and the booking process before making a commitment.

An enquiry starts a conversation. It does not reserve a trip or make a booking.

Meet your travel consultant

Hi, I’m Sarah.
I’m glad you’re here.

After two decades in customer service, I took the leap into travel. I’m excited to help you begin planning your next journey.

I’m based in Iowa and work as an independent travel consultant through Archer Travel. At home, life includes my supportive husband, my daughter, and our four Pomsky dogs.

I believe in enjoying the small and big adventures with the people you love.

Sarah
